caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which appears to be a pair of metal tongs or forceps, rendered in dark brown and black tones. The tool has two long, slightly curved handles that intersect at a central pivot point, allowing the jaws to open and close. The jaws are semicircular and each ends in a rounded, crescent-shaped tip. There is a small pin or lever protruding from one handle near the pivot, and one of the handles has a hook-like shape at the opposite end from the jaws. The object is centrally positioned on a plain, light-beige or off-white background, and there is no additional context or ornamentation in the composition. The artist’s signature, "Tony Dooley," is present in small letters near the right side of the image.
title: Loaf Sugar Cutter
